scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules app/node_modules web/node_modules desktop/node_modules deploy/node_modules
scripts.secrets:pull: doppler secrets download --no-file --format env > app/.env && echo 'app/.env regenerated from Doppler (clawed-chat/dev)'
scripts.dev:secure: doppler run -- bun run --filter clawed-chat-app dev
scripts.start:secure: doppler run -- bun run --filter clawed-chat-app start
scripts.build:secure: doppler run -- bun run --filter clawed-chat-app build
